Messages.Author: Jyhad_addict
Messages.Body:
I have heard a rumour that LSJ has said that kraken's kiss works like
this:
"if you take more than 3 damage in the resulting combat, even if you
prevent some of it, you go to torpor".
Looking into previous postings i have discovered that LSJ has said
quite the opposite. That the "more than 3 damage" must be successfuly
inflicted.
So to straighten this out once and for all: i strike opposing
minion with Kraken's kiss, he strikes me for 4, i prevent 1 (from
sideslip, Guardian Angel, e.t.c ) i do not go into torpor, because
only 3 was successfuly inflicted, right ?
and a 2nd question: I strike with kraken's kiss supperior, i play
pursuit sup. and i steal 2, i press, in the 2nd round i steal 2 with
my initial strike, play blur for 2 additional strikes, using my 1st
additional i strike with sup. kraken's kiss, does the recently played
kraken's kiss allow me to use my 2nd additional to steal 2 blood ? i
believe it does, because effects stack by default, right ?
If the answer is yes and i press, during the 3rd round can i steal
2 blood (using the effect of the sup. Kr.Kiss i have played in round
1) and steal another 2 as an additional strike (using the effect of
the sup. Kr.Kiss i have played in round 2) ?

Messages.Author: Darby Keeney
Messages.Body:
geo...@for.auth.gr (Jyhad_addict) wrote in message news:<c6a50f81.04062...@posting.google.com>...

> "if you take more than 3 damage in the resulting combat, even if you
> prevent some of it, you go to torpor".

Incorrect

> That the "more than 3 damage" must be successfuly inflicted.

Correct.

Google for "kraken inflict author:lsj"

> So to straighten this out once and for all: i strike opposing
> minion with Kraken's kiss, he strikes me for 4, i prevent 1 (from
> sideslip, Guardian Angel, e.t.c ) i do not go into torpor, because
> only 3 was successfuly inflicted, right ?

See above.

> and a 2nd question: I strike with kraken's kiss supperior, i play
> pursuit sup. and i steal 2, i press, in the 2nd round i steal 2 with
> my initial strike, play blur for 2 additional strikes, using my 1st
> additional i strike with sup. kraken's kiss, does the recently played
> kraken's kiss allow me to use my 2nd additional to steal 2 blood?

Yes.

You generated the ability for the second steal with the second Kiss.
Its no different than what you did in the first round (play the Kiss,
use an additional strike to steal).

> If the answer is yes and i press, during the 3rd round can i steal
> 2 blood (using the effect of the sup. Kr.Kiss i have played in round
> 1) and steal another 2 as an additional strike (using the effect of
> the sup. Kr.Kiss i have played in round 2) ?

Yes,

Nit: You must generate the additional strike in some way - you seem to
have left it out of your description.

Seems easier and more robust to put the Drum on Goratrix, but happy
stealing.....

Darby
